name: 2404.16130v2-GraphRAG_1.pdf
description: This document presents GraphRAG, a graph-based retrieval-augmented generation method that builds an LLM-derived entity knowledge graph, partitions it into hierarchical communities, summarizes them bottom-up, and answers global sensemaking queries via map-reduce over those summaries, with evaluation showing improved comprehensiveness and diversity over vector RAG on two ~1M-token corpora using LLM-as-a-judge.
